recordings.name: hid.rzx

verify.note: The default runs no hook, so the replay proves Enhanced: at every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM against the original to where they meet again; Layer 2 against an independent picture from the set's planes after every print, and the model's cells against the ULA every 64 hooks; ABI cases (with an interrupt inside a hook) and 21 broken builds. Pace, soak, flicker and the real loader are in games/booty.md "Evidence".

status.title: Booty
status.build: v1.0; booty_loading.nex 6393a6f9 and booty_enhanced_loading.nex 8113662c equal the published .nxc 1.0 bare builds, default and Enhanced (without the screen 7a41de52, ebc40ec7); default: the original game, no game byte changed, no hook, Sinclair's ROM as the whole alt ROM, no clash to remove and none claimed; Enhanced, off by default: the Spec256 set's pixels on a Layer 2 over the unchanged ULA; top bank 47, fits a 1MB Next
status.software: 5 recordings, 32,815 frames (a1 to 6,000, over to 9,000), 269,627 hooks with R and 48K RAM, 3,655 Layer 2 pictures against the set's planes, 1,455,922 ULA cells; 768 ABI cases and 4 with an interrupt inside a hook, 21 of 21 broken builds; ROM paths complete (the two alt ROM hook sites known); review run: pace in JNext in lockstep, music off: whole runs and thirds within 2% (Enhanced -1.00% to +0.99%), but the slowest 20-update stretch in hold 8 reads +2.78% to +3.33% in Enhanced, against +1.95% to +2.35% in the default, which runs no hook; the default reads +0.5% whole-run with no hook; 15-minute soaks, flicker, real loader on private cards
